visual_overrides.core_identity: A flowing mass of ordinary rats whose individual bodies remain readable while the group moves like a living tide.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Many low rat bodies overlap in a directional stream with visible tails and pointed snouts but open gaps between groups.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Repeated small four-legged rat forms in varied running poses with no oversized leader.
visual_overrides.surface: Minimal fur lines and simple mostly hairless tails.
